title: Pocket player
description: A cobalt audio sleeve pairs an original soundmark with synchronized seek, transport and playback speed.
useCase: Preview an audio artifact in a compact embedded card.
interaction: Play the soundmark, seek, restart or change speed.
reducedMotion: Media time and progress remain functional with no decorative animation.
limitations: An original 12-second PCM soundmark generated in the component. Browser playback requires user activation.
look: Cobalt-blue field with a square orange cover of curved blue lines, cream sans-serif title, thin seek bar and a round cream play button.
motion: Nothing animates decoratively: during playback the audio's time updates advance the native range thumb and clock; play swaps to a pause glyph and speed cycles 1×, 1.5×, 0.75×.
adapt: Playback is the native `audio` element driven by `toggle`, the range input and its event handlers; `makeAudio` synthesizes the 12-second WAV. Replace `makeAudio` with your file URL, update the range `max` and duration label, and swap the cover SVG and title.
